3.speaker: Mansoun Leke
3.text: "As I said earlier, we've been working on this bill for a long time, Mr. President. I've always done my best to represent my people... only to keep getting blocked in the Assembly."

4.speaker: Narrator
4.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_AutonomousZone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_Centralization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false)

5.speaker: Player
5.text: "How can I help you, Mr. Leke?"

6.speaker: Mansoun Leke
6.text: "But all that we get is disrespect. MPs shouting racial slurs at us, not allowing us to speak. And it's not only the National Front..."

7.speaker: Mansoun Leke
7.text: "Now I can speak freely without Mrs. Tory leading the floor, but the outcome is no different."
7.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_Action_Court_GloriaJustice"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_VPSelection_Gloria"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn07_BludishRightsMeeting_Accept"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn07_BludishRightsMeeting_Reject"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Arrest_FetihEjall"] == true) == false)

11.speaker: Mansoun Leke
11.text: "I've always brought my people's concerns to the Assembly and raised my voice whenever our rights were in question. All we ask is that the Assembly at least have a proper discussion."

12.speaker: Mansoun Leke
12.text: "The Assembly does not take us independents seriously."

13.speaker: Mansoun Leke
13.text: "I don't even remember a time when Mrs. Tory allowed me to finish a speech."
13.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_Action_Court_GloriaJustice"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_VPSelection_Gloria"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn07_BludishRightsMeeting_Accept"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn07_BludishRightsMeeting_Reject"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Arrest_FetihEjall"] == true) == false)

14.speaker: Mansoun Leke
14.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false

15.speaker: Player
15.text: "I understand you, Mr. Leke. This discrimination against you is unacceptable."

16.speaker: Player
16.text: "I don't see what I can do. This is the cold truth of Sordish politics."

17.speaker: Mansoun Leke
17.text: "We can't have the same happen again."

18.speaker: Mansoun Leke
18.text: "That's where your help would be very valuable."

19.speaker: Mansoun Leke
19.text: "I don't think you are taking this issue seriously, Mr. President."

20.speaker: Mansoun Leke
20.text: "If you wanted to help, you could do that very easily. You cannot let this vicious cycle run its course. The USP's Bludish voters have high expectations of you."

21.speaker: Mansoun Leke
21.text: "All we need is your support for our bill."

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: He gestured at the papers that I had received from him earlier.

23.speaker: Mansoun Leke
23.text: "It's time to undo the mistakes of the Sordish state against its citizens. I only ask you to help us make this single step for good instead of staying idle."

26.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
26.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false

27.speaker: Mansoun Leke
27.text: "And you, Mr. President, have approved anti-Bludish policies."

28.speaker: Mansoun Leke
28.text: "I know, or want to believe, that you only did this to appease your base."

29.speaker: Mansoun Leke
29.text: "I am here to ask you to reconsider your stance. We can make a difference in Sordland. Together."

30.speaker: Player
30.text: "What makes you think that I only had political reasons?"

31.speaker: Player
31.text: "I don't believe I've done anything against the Bludish people."

32.speaker: Player
32.text: "It's true that I have some regrets over my actions. But how can I help you?"

36.speaker: Mansoun Leke
36.text: "You banned the only pro-Bludish democratic party in Sordland. For alleged links to the BFF..."

40.speaker: Mansoun Leke
40.text: "Are you aware of the numbers of Bludish people who were arrested because of that decision? Do you know how your police acted against us?"

50.speaker: Mansoun Leke
50.text: "And you effectively removed our language in Sordland. First from religion, and then from schools."

51.speaker: Mansoun Leke
51.text: "You targeted our faith and banned our language and our priests from the sanctuaries."
51.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) == false)

52.speaker: Mansoun Leke
52.text: "You targeted our language and banned it in schools."
52.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) == false)

53.speaker: Mansoun Leke
53.text: "What are these laws if not an attempt at cultural genocide?"

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: He eyed me closely for a few seconds.

55.speaker: Mansoun Leke
55.text: "Then please tell me, Mr. President. What was your motivation?"

56.speaker: Mansoun Leke
56.text: "You did not protect Ishval Ersen and allowed the Court to appoint a ultranationalist as the governor of Bergia."
56.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProSollist"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_AutonomousZoneOfBergia"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false)

57.speaker: Mansoun Leke
57.text: "Are you aware of the actions of the governor? How he's oppressing our people? What he's doing in our villages?"
57.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_SpecialZoneOfBergia"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_AutonomousZoneOfBergia"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_AutonomousZoneOfBergia"] == true) == false)

58.speaker: Mansoun Leke
58.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProSollist"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_AutonomousZoneOfBergia"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false)

59.speaker: Mansoun Leke
59.text: "You were not only silent about the racism in this country, you enabled it."
59.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProSollist"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_AutonomousZoneOfBergia"] == false) == false)

60.speaker: Mansoun Leke
60.text: "We should start by undoing your regrets, Mr. President."

61.speaker: Mansoun Leke
61.text: "What are these policies if not an attempt to oppress Bludish people?"
61.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn05_ReligiousHarmony_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) == false)

62.speaker: Mansoun Leke
62.text: "It is time to undo these mistakes, Mr. President."

66.speaker: Player
66.text: "The dangerous separatist sentiment in Bergia needed to be curbed."

67.speaker: Player
67.text: "True, it was political. I couldn't reject such popular requests from the nationalists."

69.speaker: Mansoun Leke
69.text: "We only want our rights as proper citizens of this country. But since the founding of this republic, we have only been further disenfranchised."

70.speaker: Mansoun Leke
70.text: "Sometimes it's easier to ignore issues that do not directly affect you."

71.speaker: Mansoun Leke
71.text: "But this system of Sordland that feeds on the Bludish people's suffering will one day explode."

72.speaker: Player
72.text: "What are you asking me to do?"

73.speaker: Player
73.text: "You are right, Mr. Leke. I'm not proud of my decisions."

74.speaker: Player
74.text: "Why should I undo what I did?"

75.speaker: Mansoun Leke
75.text: "I thought you would understand. As someone who made it to this position from the farmlands of outer Deyr..."

86.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
86.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Weaker"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Removed"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false

87.speaker: Mansoun Leke
87.text: "Talk to your fellow USP members and put your support behind our bill. Our proposal will give amnesty to those who were falsely arrested for having ties to the democratic Bludish Freedom Party."

88.speaker: Mansoun Leke
88.text: "And it will form a Commission for Minority Rights."

89.speaker: Mansoun Leke
89.text: "We have a proposal to give amnesty to those who were falsely arrested for having ties to the democratic Bludish Freedom Party. Pass it as a decree. You don't need the Assembly."
89.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Weaker"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Removed"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false

90.speaker: Mansoun Leke
90.text: "And let us independents form a Commission for Minority Rights."

91.speaker: Player
91.text: "Yes, you were. And I think our meeting is now over."

92.speaker: Player
92.text: "What do you want me to do?"

93.speaker: Mansoun Leke
93.text: "And it will lift the ban on the Bludish Freedom Party. As well as giving amnesty to all who were arrested for having ties to it."

95.speaker: Mansoun Leke
95.text: "Their families are still waiting for them in Bergia..."'

96.speaker: Player
96.text: "I don't think I can support this proposal, Mr. Leke."

97.speaker: Player
97.text: "I agree with you completely, Mr. Leke. Thank you for representing this noble cause."

98.speaker: Mansoun Leke
98.text: "Our proposal aims to form a Committee for Minority Rights."

99.speaker: Mansoun Leke
99.text: "It's not Tarquin Soll's era anymore. It's time we try to clean up the taint he left on our history."

100.speaker: Player
100.text: "Exactly. By the way, his trial is next month. You can attend it if you want to."

106.speaker: Mansoun Leke
106.text: "Oh, thank you. I will *definitely* be there."

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: He looked at me with a stolid expression.

110.speaker: Player
110.text: "It's a no, Mr. Leke. I cannot help you."

111.speaker: Player
111.text: "It means stop hurling accusations at me and just tell me what you want."

116.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
116.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Weaker"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Removed"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false

117.speaker: Player
117.text: "Yes. I'll form the commission and support your bill in the Assembly."

118.speaker: Player
118.text: "Yes. I'll form the commission and sign your proposal as a decree."
118.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Weaker"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Decree_Removed"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false

119.speaker: Player
119.text: "As much as I want to, I don't think this is the right time. The nationalists would be furious."

122.speaker: Player
122.text: "It's a no, Mr. Leke. I cannot help you."

123.speaker: Player
123.text: "This isn't the right time. The nationalists would have my head for this."

124.speaker: Mansoun Leke
124.text: "You're that scared of losing your *racist* voters ahead of the elections?"

125.speaker: Player
125.text: "I can't help the Bluds while my own people suffer."

126.speaker: Player
126.text: "I can't help the Bluds while my own people suffer."

127.speaker: Mansoun Leke
127.text: "I never thought you were an ethnonationalist."

130.speaker: Player
130.text: "I don't think I can help you, Mr. Leke."

136.speaker: Narrator
136.text: He rose up and walked up to me. He extended a hand.

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: He rose and walked up to me. He extended a hand.

154.speaker: Player
154.text: "I don't know what you're talking about, Mr. Leke. I had no power over these matters."

158.speaker: Mansoun Leke
158.text: "Mr. President, with all due respect, you should have realized removing your veto powers would lead to this."

159.speaker: Mansoun Leke
159.text: "You knew full well the state of the assembly and the direction it would take on its own."

160.speaker: Mansoun Leke
160.text: "By doing nothing, you are enabling the Assembly's bigotry, Mr. President."

162.speaker: Mansoun Leke
162.text: "However, today, I am giving you a chance to take long-overdue action."

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: Mansoun took a deep breath, calming himself.

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: As he talked, he tightened his clenched fist.

168.speaker: Mansoun Leke
168.text: "Having said that, there has been a lot of new developments since we last spoke."

172.speaker: Mansoun Leke
172.text: "Having said that, there has been a lot of new developments since you rejected our offer to meet."
172.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn07_BludishRightsMeeting_Accept"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn07_BludishRightsMeeting_Reject"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Arrest_FetihEjall"] == true) == false)

176.speaker: Mansoun Leke
176.text: "And the Bludish rights movement is extremely happy with the new changes to the Constitution."

180.speaker: Mansoun Leke
180.text: "Despite failing to change the constitution, I should say that you earned the respect of the Bludish rights movement. I must thank you again for fighting with us."

181.speaker: Mansoun Leke
181.text: "Unfortunately, the lack of cooperation from your side has been enabling the hardline nationalists to get bolder about their racist tirades."

185.speaker: Mansoun Leke
185.text: "Luckily, you approved the new Autonomous Zone of Bergia. This was an historic accomplishment. And I must applaud you for it."

189.speaker: Mansoun Leke
189.text: "On top of all that, you approved the new Autonomous Zone of Bergia. This was an historic accomplishment. And I must applaud you for it."

193.speaker: Mansoun Leke
193.text: "On top of all that, you managed to revoke the Special Zone. This was an historic accomplishment. And I must applaud you for it."

194.speaker: Mansoun Leke
194.text: "On top of all that, you managed to revoke the Special Zone. Although this was an historic accomplishment, I'm not sure if anything really changed that drastically."

201.speaker: Mansoun Leke
201.text: "And Governor Bron is still in charge of the Special Zone... Free to continue his oppressive policies against the Bludish community."
201.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_AutonomousZone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_Centralization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true)

205.speaker: Mansoun Leke
205.text: "And an ultranationalist is now governing the Special Zone... Continuing his oppressive policies against the Bludish community behind the scenes."
205.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_AutonomousZone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_Centralization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true)

209.speaker: Mansoun Leke
209.text: "But Governor Bron is still in charge of the Special Zone... Free to continue his oppressive policies against the Bludish community."
209.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_AutonomousZone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_Centralization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true)

213.speaker: Mansoun Leke
213.text: "But an ultranationalist is now governing the Special Zone... Continuing his oppressive policies against the Bludish community behind the scenes."
213.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_AutonomousZone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_Centralization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true)

215.speaker: Mansoun Leke
215.text: "However, there is still a lot to do."

216.speaker: Mansoun Leke
216.text: "And something must be done about this."

217.speaker: Mansoun Leke
217.text: "Luckily, we got rid of the governor. This has already helped with decreasing the tensions."
217.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_AutonomousZone"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_PresiPower_Default_BergiaSpecialZone_Centralization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false)

222.speaker: Mansoun Leke
222.text: "The Bludish community it extremely happy about these developments. You've definitely earned their support."

223.speaker: Mansoun Leke
223.text: "I came here today to show you our gratitude and thank you again personally."

224.speaker: Mansoun Leke
224.text: "According to the movement, there is still one more thing to do. We'd appreciate your help on it."

225.speaker: Player
225.text: "How can I help you, Mr. Leke?"

226.speaker: Player
226.text: "Of course. Just tell me what you need."

227.speaker: Player
227.text: "I'm not sure if I can do more after all I've done for your people."

229.speaker: Mansoun Leke
229.text: "I understand where you're coming from, Mr. President, but please hear us out."

230.speaker: Mansoun Leke
230.text: "We just want you to undo the mistakes of the Sordish state against Bludish political movements."

238.speaker: Mansoun Leke
238.text: "After all you've done, is this really such a major thing for you or the nationalists?"

240.speaker: Mansoun Leke
240.text: "This is very disappointing. But I understand."

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: He stopped for a moment and repositioned himself on his seat.

245.speaker: Mansoun Leke
245.text: "And considering now that I'm representing the Workers Party in the Assembly as its new leader..."

246.speaker: Mansoun Leke
246.text: "...I have a lot more responsibility against my people."

250.speaker: Mansoun Leke
250.text: "The Assembly does not take the Workers Party seriously."

254.speaker: Mansoun Leke
254.text: "Are you aware of the actions of the Minister of Interior? How she's making life difficult for some locals? What her police is doing to our community leaders?"

258.speaker: Mansoun Leke
258.text: "The situation might be better now with the autonomous zone but the history of our people and their memories will remain."
258.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_SpecialZoneOfBergia"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_AutonomousZoneOfBergia"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_AutonomousZoneOfBergia"] == true)

262.speaker: Mansoun Leke
262.text: "It will revoke the current ban and allow both the Worker's Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Party into politics once more."

266.speaker: Mansoun Leke
266.text: "Needless to say, your decree must also revoke the current ban and allow both the Worker's Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Party into politics once more."
